metric: login -> sound: wall clock of hearing-aids-connect.service (Starting -> Finished), seconds
guardrails: gnome-shell %CPU with vs without the extension
environment: Fedora 44, kernel 7.1.13, BlueZ 5.87, PipeWire 1.6.8, WirePlumber 0.5.14, GNOME 50.4, Intel AX211, ReSound Vivia 960 x2
excluded: 3 boots where the aids were in their charger or the machine suspended mid-script (service failed): not a performance sample
note: One sample per reboot; n=3 is below the 10-run rule, the spread on 'connect' (7.8 to 17.3 s) is the aids, not the script. 'pre' is a fixed sleep (ExecStartPre=/bin/sleep 8) plus script start.
